## Sourcing checklist (required for any dossier change)
- [ ] Every quotation traces to a **real, linked public source** (no fabricated quotes)
- [ ] Inferences/extrapolations are clearly marked as such, not as the person's words
- [ ] Critiques are real, sourced, and neutrally worded (no invented scandal)
- [ ] `sources[]` updated with working URLs; `source_count` and `last_updated` updated
- [ ] For a new advisor: **all sections** filled and ≥5 real sources (or thinness noted in Provenance)
- [ ] I followed [`reference/voice-guide.md`](../reference/voice-guide.md) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
